content.text:
I fixed it in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`. When `v-for` looped over a `shallowReactive` array, each item was converted to a deeply reactive object. That unwrapped the item's nested refs, which is why `item.aaa` showed up as a string instead of a ref.

The fix: items are still converted for normal reactive arrays, but not when the array is shallow (checked with `isShallow`). For `shallowReactive` arrays, `v-for` now passes the raw items through. In the issue's example both outputs should now be `object`.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7/7). I didn't add a test for the shallow case or run the issue's reproduction.

I fixed it in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`. When `v-for` looped over a `shallowReactive` array, each item was converted to a deeply reactive object. That unwrapped the item's nested refs, which is why `item.aaa` showed up as a string instead of a ref.

The fix: items are still converted for normal reactive arrays, but not when the array is shallow (checked with `isShallow`). For `shallowReactive` arrays, `v-for` now passes the raw items through. In the issue's example both outputs should now be `object`.
